newsitem.title: USA: Healthdyne to consider Invacare bid.
newsitem.headline: Healthdyne to consider Invacare bid.

text.p: Healthdyne Technologies Inc said on Friday that it would consider in due course the Invacare Corp's $12.50 a share bid to buy the company.
Healthdyne said it was surprised the Invacare would announce its bid prior to the company's review of it and after Invacare had requested confidentiality of its proposal to negotiate.
Healthdyne said Invacare's offer has been referred to its board and noted that the offer is a discount from its stock price in mid-1996.
Healthdyne said it previously had determined that a sale is not in the best interests of its shareholders, but that it would consider and respond to Invacare's proposal.
